title: Returning a jacket without a receipt
context: You will hear a customer talking to a sales associate at an outdoor clothing store in Vancouver.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Hi there, what can I help you with?

segments.speaker: Kwame
segments.text: Hi. So, I bought this jacket here maybe three weeks ago, and the zipper's already broken. See? It just comes right off the track.

segments.speaker: Kwame
segments.text: I'd like to return it, but, well, I can't find the receipt anywhere.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Oh, that's not good. Yeah, that zipper's definitely broken. Okay, without a receipt, normally the most I could do is store credit, and only for whatever the jacket's selling for today.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Let me check. It's on sale right now, so two twenty-nine.

segments.speaker: Kwame
segments.text: Ouch. I paid almost three hundred for it. I bought it before the sale started.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Right. But hang on, did you pay by card? If you've got the card with you, I can search for the transaction. If it comes up, it's as good as a receipt.

segments.speaker: Kwame
segments.text: I think so. I used my debit card, I'm pretty sure. Here you go.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Thanks. And do you remember roughly which day?

segments.speaker: Kwame
segments.text: It was a Saturday, the first weekend of November. Or maybe the second.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Okay, give me a sec. There it is. November eighth, two eighty-nine ninety-nine. Perfect. So now you've got options. Because it's a defect, I can do a full refund back to your card, or I can exchange it for a new one.

segments.speaker: Kwame
segments.text: I actually really like the jacket. It's warm. I just want one with a zipper that works.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Makes sense. The only thing is, we're out of large in navy right now. I could order one from our Richmond store, which usually takes three to five business days. Or there's the black one in large, right here.

segments.speaker: Kwame
segments.text: Hmm. I'd rather wait for the navy. My old jacket's still in the closet, so I'll survive a few more days.

segments.speaker: Sophie
segments.text: Great, I'll set that up. We'll text you when it arrives, and just bring in this jacket when you pick it up.

questions.prompt: Without proof of purchase, what could the store normally offer?

options.text: A full refund to the original card.
options.whyVi: Hoàn tiền đầy đủ chỉ có sau khi tìm được giao dịch; không có hóa đơn thì không được.

options.text: Store credit equal to the jacket's current lower price.
options.whyVi: Đúng: chỉ tín dụng cửa hàng theo giá đang bán hôm nay (229 đô, đang giảm giá).

options.text: Store credit for the full amount he paid.
options.whyVi: Tín dụng chỉ bằng giá hiện tại, không phải số tiền anh đã trả.

options.text: A free repair of the zipper.
options.whyVi: Không ai nhắc tới việc sửa khóa kéo.

questions.evidence: normally the most I could do is store credit, and only for whatever the jacket's selling for today
questions.explanationVi: 'Whatever the jacket's selling for today' + 'It's on sale right now' = giá hiện tại thấp hơn. Đáp án B gộp hai thông tin này.

questions.prompt: How did the sales associate find a record of the purchase?

options.text: Kwame found an email receipt on his phone.
options.whyVi: Không có biên lai email nào; anh không tìm được hóa đơn.

options.text: She looked up his name in the customer rewards list.
options.whyVi: Bài không nhắc chương trình khách hàng thân thiết.

options.text: She searched for the transaction using his payment card.
options.whyVi: Đúng: cô dùng thẻ ghi nợ của anh và ngày mua để tìm giao dịch.

options.text: Kwame remembered the exact date and price.
options.whyVi: Anh chỉ nhớ đại khái ('first weekend... or maybe the second'); thẻ mới là cách tìm ra.

questions.evidence: If you've got the card with you, I can search for the transaction.
questions.explanationVi: 'Search for the transaction' bằng thẻ = tìm giao dịch qua thẻ thanh toán. 'Debit card' là một loại 'payment card'.

questions.prompt: How much did Kwame originally pay for the jacket?

options.text: Two hundred and twenty-nine dollars.
options.whyVi: Đây là giá giảm hiện tại, không phải giá anh đã trả.

options.text: Exactly three hundred dollars.
options.whyVi: Anh nói 'almost three hundred' – gần 300, không phải đúng 300.

options.text: Two hundred and ninety-nine dollars.
options.whyVi: Nghe nhầm 'ninety-nine' (99 xu) thành 299 đô; giá đúng là 289,99 đô.

options.text: A little under two hundred and ninety dollars.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 289,99 đô, tức là chỉ dưới 290 đô một chút.

questions.explanationVi: 'Two eighty-nine ninety-nine' = 289,99 đô. Người Canada thường đọc giá theo kiểu này. 229 là giá sale; 'almost three hundred' là cách nói ước lượng.

questions.prompt: Why does Kwame choose an exchange instead of a refund?

options.text: He is happy with the jacket apart from the faulty zipper.
options.whyVi: Đúng: anh thích áo, áo ấm, chỉ muốn khóa kéo hoạt động.

options.text: The store does not give refunds for sale items.
options.whyVi: Nhân viên nói rõ có thể hoàn tiền đầy đủ vì là lỗi sản phẩm.

options.text: He prefers the black jacket that is in stock.
options.whyVi: Anh chọn chờ màu xanh navy, không lấy áo đen.

options.text: He wants to use the money as store credit.
options.whyVi: 'Store credit' được nhắc ở đầu nhưng không phải lựa chọn cuối cùng.

questions.evidence: I actually really like the jacket. It's warm. I just want one with a zipper that works.
questions.explanationVi: Thái độ: anh hài lòng với áo ('really like... It's warm'), chỉ có vấn đề ở khóa kéo. 'A zipper that works' ↔ 'apart from the faulty zipper'.

questions.prompt: What will Kwame do with the broken jacket?

options.text: Leave it at the store today.
options.whyVi: Nhân viên bảo mang áo theo khi đến nhận áo mới, không phải để lại hôm nay.

options.text: Mail it to the Richmond store.
options.whyVi: Richmond là nơi gửi áo mới đến, anh không phải gửi áo cũ đi.

options.text: Hand it in when he collects the replacement.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'just bring in this jacket when you pick it up'.

options.text: Keep it as a spare in his closet.
options.whyVi: Cái áo trong tủ là áo cũ khác của anh, không phải áo bị hỏng.

questions.evidence: We'll text you when it arrives, and just bring in this jacket when you pick it up.
questions.explanationVi: Thông tin ở câu cuối, dễ lỡ: 'bring in this jacket when you pick it up'. 'Pick it up' = 'collects the replacement'.

vocabulary.vi: tín dụng mua hàng tại cửa hàng
vocabulary.definition: an amount you can spend at a store instead of getting cash back
vocabulary.example: Without a receipt, we can only give store credit.
I can search for the transaction with your card.

vocabulary.definition: a fault in the way something was made
vocabulary.example: Because it's a defect, you can get a full refund.

vocabulary.definition: to give back an item and receive another one
vocabulary.example: I'd like to exchange it for a new one.
We're out of large in navy right now.

vocabulary.definition: almost the same as; equal in effect to
vocabulary.example: The card record is as good as a receipt.

review.notes: Blind-solved all 5 Qs; key matched. Q3 ('two eighty-nine ninety-nine' = $289.99 -> 'a little under $290') verified as the only defensible answer against $229 / ~$300 / $299. Nov 8 = second weekend of November is consistent with the 'first or second' hesitation. No changes needed.
